verdict.rationale: Deel offers a broad REST API (contracts, payroll data) plus an MCP server exposing many operations (time-off requests, contract listing, EOR cost calculations) and webhooks/sandbox tooling, indicating substantial API coverage of core workflows. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of full UI-API parity, and community feedback describes rigid workflows and persistent UI bugs, suggesting some functionality may not be fully exposed or automatable via API.
